nodes.summary: Let $G$ be a finite group. For every message $m \in G$, the ciphertext of $m$ under the group one-time pad on $G$, whose key is drawn uniformly from $G$, is uniformly distributed on $G$.
nodes.title: Group one-time pad ciphertexts are uniform

nodes.summary: Let $G$ be a finite group. The group one-time pad on $G$ is perfectly secret: for every probability distribution on messages in $G$ and every ciphertext $c$ that occurs with positive probability, the conditional distribution of the message given that the ciphertext is $c$ equals the prior distribution of the message.
nodes.title: The group one-time pad is perfectly secret

nodes.summary: Let $G$ be a finite group. The group one-time pad on $G$ is the private-key encryption scheme with messages, keys and ciphertexts in $G$ whose key $k$ is drawn uniformly from $G$, which encrypts a message $m$ as $k m$, and which decrypts a ciphertext $c$ as $k^{-1} c$.
nodes.title: The group one-time pad
